text.en: Clients speak very highly of senior vets Catherine and Fintan, alongside supportive receptionists and nurses. Reviewers who have visited the Hodge Hill clinic for decades emphasize the team's professional bedside manner, reassuring guidance, and readiness to explain procedures clearly with informative diagrams.

Pet owners appreciate the deep empathy shown toward dogs and cats during check-ups, neutering, and end-of-life care. Clients note that clinicians handle rescues and nervous animals with patience, ensuring pets feel calm and secure throughout their examinations and medical therapies.

Reviewers report positive medical outcomes for complex dental surgeries, tumour removals, and routine vaccinations. Long-term pet owners credit thorough examinations and timely interventions with saving their companions' lives and providing effective pain relief for ageing dogs and cats.

q.en: Does The Lodge Veterinary Centre in Hodge Hill perform dental surgery?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention successful pet dental treatments and oral surgeries carried out by experienced clinicians.

q.en: Are routine neutering and microchipping services available?

a.en: Yes, the practice regularly provides pet neutering, vaccinations, and microchip implants for cats and dogs.

q.en: How long has the clinic served the local community?

a.en: Several reviewers note they have brought their family pets to the Hodge Hill practice for over twenty to thirty years.

q.en: How do clients view consultation fees at the practice?

a.en: Reviewers consider the charges reasonable and competitive compared with other private veterinary surgeries in the area.
